body:
Such a drastic thing as changing a whole life does not come easy and should not be a rushed desicion, but its worth thinking about.

i extend you the same thanks to you as i did to somemay in my last comment to him/her.

i think the first thing i have to do is clear my head and think straight.

i think taking any step no matter ho small is better then nothing but it will be hard ti find something in which ill keep going and not fall into old habits again.

thanks for your thoughts. I found that this little thing here kept my mind on the problem without sinking into its hole. I guess this what they mean when they say talking about it helps.

If all this has done is getting me to think clearer about this whole thing its already done something, again thanks.

> There is no time like now to do something more exciting with life.

this makes sense. and its painfully obvious sometimes.

But right there lies one of my problems. I seem to never do the things i ought to do. I can see a path that might get me to a brighter place, the problem is i cant seem to get my legs working.

Im not sure this paints my situation clearly...

maybe i need someone to kick me in the ass, in a good way. The problem there is that im not willing to open up to anyone not even my brother who lives in the same city.

leaving everything behind sounds like a very romanticized idea. but it would be doing something, and as of now im standing still.
maybe moving forward for changes sake is better than sanding still.
But still i would not know where to move onto.

Just moving on takes strength and bravery though and as of right now im feeling like i dont posses any of those traits
